thread:
cara_pm: Quick sync request 10m: vendor sent a revised compatibility matrix. H200 slip + new B200 power profile. Need to lock image naming and marketplace gating before we open SKUs.

dev_vendor: Correct. H200 GA moved to 2025-04-20; B200 variant B200-L has a sustained-power caveat above 680W. We're prepping a firmware patch (fw-1.3.0) but it's not validated in partner labs yet.

sam_platform: We should finalize an image tag convention today so CI can auto-gate. Proposal: `redwood/market/{vendor}/{model}/fw-{ver}/sha-{short}`. Any objections?

jules_market: That naming works. Marketplace needs image SHA + declared region list before SKU unlock. Also require legal-approved partner quote for co-announcement (7 business days).

maya_si: SI requirements: final firmware blob + SHA, integration checklist, and a 48h soak recipe across two regions. If B200 shows derate in our soak, we need rollback steps.

dev_vendor: We'll upload fw-1.3.0 candidate and SKU impact list by EOD tomorrow. If lab shows regressions, GA may slip by up to 14 days.

sam_platform: I'll open a CI gating PR with the tag pattern and a gating rule: fail on temp > 84C or perf drop > 10%. Example rule in PR.

cara_pm: Actions (owners/due): dev_vendor: firmware + SKU delta (EOD tomorrow); sam_platform: CI PR (48h); maya_si: soak template + rollback stub (48h); jules_market: embargo draft + legal loop (sync).

event-bot: cara_pm scheduled "B200/H200 marketplace prep: image tags & soak" on 2025-03-25 14:00 PT. Invite sent.

jules_market: Added legal and PR. If anything blocks before the sync drop notes here.

cara_pm: Thanks all. We'll triage in the meeting. :thumbsup:
